moments.title: The Hundred Cricket Finals
moments.blurb: The finals of The Hundred men's and women's cricket tournaments take place this Sunday, wrapping up a month of high-octane 100-ball action.

angles.name: Finals Fever
angles.copy: It all comes down to this! The Hundred finals are on Sunday. Who are you backing to lift the trophy?

angles.name: Cricket Showdown
angles.copy: Big weekend ahead for cricket fans! The Hundred reaches its thrilling conclusion this Sunday. Will it be your team celebrating?

moments.title: European Athletics Championships
moments.blurb: The European Athletics Championships are underway in Birmingham, running until August 16, with top athletes competing across track and field events.

angles.name: Birmingham Athletics
angles.copy: The European Athletics Championships are bringing world-class talent to Birmingham all week! Catch the action at Alexander Stadium.

angles.name: Track and Field
angles.copy: It's a huge week for track and field as the European Athletics Championships continue in Birmingham. Who are you watching out for?

moments.title: FA Community Shield
moments.blurb: The traditional curtain-raiser for the English football season, the FA Community Shield, takes place this Saturday at Wembley Stadium.

angles.name: Football's Back
angles.copy: The domestic football season officially kicks off this Saturday with the FA Community Shield at Wembley! Who's taking home the first silverware?

angles.name: Wembley Opener
angles.copy: Wembley Stadium hosts the FA Community Shield this Saturday – a taste of Premier League action before the season officially begins!

moments.title: Boomtown Festival
moments.blurb: The immersive Boomtown Festival, featuring Madness and Scissor Sisters, kicks off tomorrow in Hampshire, running until August 16.

angles.name: Boomtown Begins
angles.copy: Boomtown Fair starts tomorrow! Get ready for a week of incredible music, art, and immersive experiences. Who's heading to Winchester?

angles.name: Festival Vibes
angles.copy: Madness and Scissor Sisters are among the acts at Boomtown Festival this week! Get ready for some serious festival vibes.

moments.title: Green Man Festival
moments.blurb: Wales' largest music, arts, and science festival, Green Man, takes place from August 20-23 in the Brecon Beacons, featuring headliners Mogwai, Wilco, Four Tet, and Wolf Alice.

angles.name: Green Man Calling
angles.copy: Green Man Festival is just around the corner! Get ready for a fantastic blend of music, arts, and science in the beautiful Brecon Beacons, August 20-23.

angles.name: Welsh Festival
angles.copy: Big names like Mogwai and Wolf Alice are heading to the Brecon Beacons next week for Green Man Festival! Who's excited for the Welsh music extravaganza?

moments.title: Reading & Leeds Festival Lineup
moments.blurb: Reading & Leeds Festivals (August 27-30) have revealed their star-studded lineup including Charli XCX, Dave, Florence + The Machine, and Fontaines D.C. across both sites.

angles.name: R&L Headliners
angles.copy: The full lineup for Reading & Leeds is out! Charli XCX, Dave, Florence + The Machine... who are you most buzzing to see later this month?

angles.name: Festival Countdown
angles.copy: Reading & Leeds Festival: just over two weeks away! Who's got their tickets for Bramham Park or Richfield Avenue?
